title: RPA directly stimulates Mer3 helicase processivity to ensure normal crossover formation in meiosis.
authors: Altmannova, Veronika; Orlic, Lucija; Carrasco, Carolina; Adam, Celine; Aicart-Ramos, Clara; Guerrini, Dario; Janning, Petra; Borde, Valerie; Matos, Joao; Moreno-Herrero, Fernando; Weir, John R
one_liner_zh: 该文研究RPA与Mer3解旋酶互作促进减数分裂交叉形成，涉及蛋白-DNA互作界面建模（AlphaFold2）与单分子力学实验，但核心非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作建模。
abstract: Meiotic crossover formation is critical for generating viable gametes and enhancing genetic diversity. The helicase Mer3 (HFM1 in humans) is a highly conserved factor essential for promoting crossovers and ensuring their proper distribution. Here, we identify replication protein A (RPA) as a direct interactor of budding yeast Mer3. We demonstrate that this interaction is conserved between human HFM1 and RPA. Cross-linking mass spectrometry and structural modelling with AlphaFold2 reveal a conserved and specific Mer3-RPA interface. Single-molecule magnetic tweezers assays demonstrate that direct RPA interaction is required for Mer3 helicase processivity under conditions of low DNA tension. Consistently, a mer3 mutant deficient in RPA binding exhibits reduced crossover frequencies and accumulates unresolved recombination intermediates during budding yeast meiosis. Via genome-wide localisation experiments, we link this effect to weakened recruitment of the mer3 mutant to double-strand break sites. Our findings provide mechanistic insights into coordination of meiotic recombination by the Mer3 helicase through interactions with the canonical DNA repair machinery, highlighting a conserved mechanism underlying crossover control during sexual reproduction.
abstract_zh: 减数分裂交叉形成对于产生可行配子和增强遗传多样性至关重要。解旋酶Mer3（人类中的HFM1）是促进交叉形成并确保其正确分布的高度保守因子。在此，我们鉴定出复制蛋白A（replication protein A, RPA）是芽殖酵母Mer3的直接相互作用伙伴。我们证明这种相互作用在人类HFM1与RPA之间是保守的。交联质谱和AlphaFold2结构建模揭示了一个保守且特异的Mer3-RPA界面。单分子磁镊实验表明，在低DNA张力条件下，直接的RPA相互作用是Mer3解旋酶持续合成能力所必需的。一致地，一个缺乏RPA结合的mer3突变体在芽殖酵母减数分裂期间表现出降低的交叉频率并积累未解决的重组中间体。通过全基因组定位实验，我们将这一效应与mer3突变体在双链断裂位点招募减弱联系起来。我们的发现为Mer3解旋酶通过与经典DNA修复机制的相互作用协调减数分裂重组提供了机制性见解，突显了有性生殖中交叉控制的一个保守机制。
